# 0 Keepers of the Lamp

A lighthouse is a promise made to ships. It burns whether or not a ship is near.[^1][^2]
The keeper kept that promise for the harbour.[^3]

[^1]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#2. Keepers of the Lamp]] "A lighthouse is a promise made to ships."
[^2]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#2. Keepers of the Lamp]] "It burns whether or not a ship is near."
[^3]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#2. Keepers of the Lamp]] "The keeper kept that promise for the harbour."
